entries.name: document-post-line-freeze
entries.claim: A line create, update or archive on a Ready or Posted journal is refused: every line write applies the header's update guard through the declared parent-scoped relation.

kills.name: line create, update and archive are refused once the draft is Ready, and once it is Posted
kills.expected: on a Ready draft was admitted

entries.name: document-post-header-lock
entries.claim: The post holds the journal header FOR NO KEY UPDATE before its one read, so a line change committed while it waited is posted, never missed.
entries.original: ' AND %I = $3 AND %I IS NULL FOR NO KEY UPDATE',

kills.name: the post reads every line committed while it waited on the header
kills.expected: the post missed a line change committed while it waited

entries.name: document-post-backstop
entries.claim: One manual entry per journal: a journal forced back to Ready meets the record-ID unique index (ledger.documentPosted), whatever its state field says.
entries.original: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ledger_entries_document_key ON platform.ledger_entries

kills.name: a draft forced back to Ready cannot post a second entry
kills.expected: a draft forced back to Ready posted a second entry: admitted

entries.name: document-post-grant-capability
entries.claim: The post consumes a grant only under its own capability constant: a grant attested for books start is refused.
entries.replacement: invocation := north_star_internal.ledger_consume_grant(grant_key, (SELECT g.capability_id FROM platform.ledger_approval_grants g WHERE g.grant_id = grant_key),

kills.name: a grant attested for books start never applies in the post
kills.expected: the post consumed a grant attested for books start

entries.name: document-post-permission
entries.claim: journal_post is the money gate in SQL: books_configure alone cannot post a journal (the control admits books_configure beside journal_post).

kills.name: journal_post is the money gate: books_configure alone cannot post, and each layer refuses without its grant

entries.name: document-post-company-scope
entries.claim: Authority is checked for the journal's stored company, never the caller's: a principal scoped to company A cannot post company B's journal.
entries.replacement: IF NOT north_star_internal.ledger_may(coalesce((SELECT m.legal_entity_id FROM platform.current_policy_memberships m WHERE m.principal_id = nullif(current_setting('north_star.principal_id', true), '')::uuid AND m.legal_entity_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1), company), 'northstar.ledger:permission.journal_post', 'northstar.ledger:capability.journal')

kills.name: a principal of company A cannot post company B's journal, nor book to B's account codes
kills.expected: a principal of company A posted company B's journal

entries.name: document-post-minor-units
entries.claim: Amounts convert to whole minor units exactly: a fraction of the minor unit refuses (ledger.unrepresentableAmount) and is never rounded.
entries.original: IF amount <> trunc(amount, exponent) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ledger.unrepresentableAmount'; END IF;

kills.name: amounts are whole minor units: 0, -1.00 and 0.001 CAD refuse, and the conversion is exact at exponents 0, 2, 3 and 4

entries.name: document-post-revision
entries.claim: The post pins the Ready revision the person confirmed: after a reopen, edit and Ready again, the earlier confirmation refuses (ledger.staleRevision).
entries.original: IF doc.revision IS DISTINCT FROM (input->>'expectedRevision')::bigint THEN
entries.replacement: IF false AND (input->>'expectedRevision') IS NOT NULL THEN

kills.name: a confirmation of the Ready revision before a reopen, edit and Ready again is refused
kills.expected: a post confirmed on an earlier Ready revision applied

entries.name: document-post-posted-unreachable
entries.claim: No declared or customized transition reaches Posted: only the ledger's definer posts, so the compiler refuses a package that adds one.

kills.name: DOCUMENT-POSTING: Customize cannot unfreeze a posted document; the compiler refuses by name
kills.expected: a customized package with a transition into Posted compiled
